duramen 0.1
spec s 1
oracle node echo.mjs
op f
  input say? string
req A "a"
  example raw '{"id": "r1", "op": "f", "input": {"say": " \u00a0\n{\"id\": \"elsewhere\", \"result\": 1}\n\t"}}'
    expect result = 1
  example raw '{"id": "r2", "op": accepted "input": {"say": "{\"id\": \"r2\", \"result\": 1}\r\n"}}'
    expect result = 1
  example raw '{"id": "r3", "op": "f", "input": {"say": "{\"result\": 1}\r{\"result\": 2}"}}'
    expect result = ?
  example raw '{"id": "r4", "op": "f", "input": {"say": "{\"result\": 1}\n[2]"}}'
    expect result = ?
